title: Cosmic Nightmare Tree
description: A large twisted black tree with white linework grows against a dark green starry night sky containing a red ringed planet, shooting stars, and a glowing full moon. The tree's branches are entwined with multiple screaming human-like faces, purple crystalline leaves, and a giant purple and black monster head with glowing eyes and a jagged toothy grin. In the foreground, a small astronaut stands on a branch looking up, while another tiny astronaut stands inside the moon. Purple crystals cover the ground below.
prompt: A surreal dark fantasy scene featuring a massive twisted black tree with white outlines against a deep green starry night sky. The tree is covered in purple crystal leaves and multiple screaming human faces growing from the branches. A giant monstrous head with glowing purple eyes and a wide jagged white grin emerges from the top of the tree. A small astronaut in a spacesuit stands on a lower branch looking up, while another tiny astronaut stands within a glowing full moon. Red ringed planet and shooting stars visible in the sky, purple crystals on the ground below, eerie and cosmic horror atmosphere.
